bullets.title: Euro Telcos 2027: SpaceX C-band overhang clouds H1, consolidation catalysts drive H2 recovery
bullets.body: JPM sees European telcos facing H1 2027 headwinds from SpaceX's potential C-band auction participation (deadline Jan 20) — if SpaceX applies (base case), M&A discussions are precluded until late July. H2 sentiment should recover as SpaceX overhangs fade and French consolidation, DT-TMUS speculation, and X.Niel's Vodafone strategy come into focus. Sector 2027E revenue growth stays below 1%, but cost cuts and normalizing capex support FCF/dividend CAGRs; DT trades at <10x 2027E PE. Top picks: BT, Orange, Bouygues, Telia, KPN, Sinch, Truecaller; underweights: Vodafone, Elisa, Sunrise, Telefonica.

bullets.title: Morgan Stanley European TMT: corporate optimism on AI demand vs. cautious investor positioning — a disconnect
bullets.body: MS's European TMT Conference flagged a notable gap between constructive corporate commentary on AI demand/monetization and cautious investor positioning across semiconductors, software, internet, and telecoms. ARM Holdings highlighted with growing conviction in its AI ramp; data center and semiconductor demand cited as among the biggest ongoing stock debates.

bullets.title: Brazil BoP: CAD stabilizes at 2.3% of GDP; FDI and portfolio inflows beat in October
bullets.body: JPMorgan notes Brazil's October current account deficit came in at US$4.0B (wider than the US$3.3B estimate), with the 12-month CAD steady at 2.3% of GDP — confirming the narrowing trend has run its course. FDI surprised to the upside at US$9.1B (~3.4% of GDP), and portfolio flows surged to a US$7.9B inflow driven by US$6.0B in fixed income, though election-related positioning may make flows volatile.

bullets.title: European financials: lending conditions stable, Greece upgrades growth outlook meaningfully
bullets.body: Jefferies sees COE-friendly conditions for European financials following the latest FPC outcome. Euro Area loan growth held at 4.5% Y/Y in October while deposit growth slowed to 3.7% from 4.2%. Greece revised its 2027 GDP forecast up 0.6pp to 2.3%, projects a primary surplus of +3.2% of GDP, and reported 9M tourism revenues up 9.7% Y/Y to €21.96B on 34.2M visitors (+8.3% Y/Y).

bullets.title: PANW faces accounting fraud lawsuit; META smart glasses halted in EU on privacy grounds
bullets.body: Palo Alto Networks is facing a lawsuit from a former executive alleging accounting fraud. Separately, a Dutch court ordered a halt to Meta smart glasses sales in the Netherlands following a privacy complaint from a Dutch consumer rights group — adding regulatory friction to META's hardware expansion in Europe.
